title: LDPC Encoder
source_docs: Wireless HDL Toolbox/Error Detection and Correction/LDPC_Encoder.md
text: Encode data with quasi-cyclic low-density parity-check code, 2 inputs, 3 outputs; {Parity-check matrix} sets the qC-LDPC matrix 0 35 1 26 0 10 16 16 34 4 2 23 0 51 -1 49 20 -1 -1 -1; 12 28 22 46 3 16 51 2 25 29 19 18 52 -1 37 -1 34 39 -1 -1; {Block size} sets the size of block. Values come from the instance.
